feed.title: Basic Pitches
feed.subtitle: "Basic Pitches" is an improvisional theatre company that grows & performs in Zurich, Switzerland. Despite not having a single native speaker, we proudly perform in English with a wide variety accents and oddities.

entry.title: Halloween Musical
entry.content:
Get ready for a frightfully fun night of improvised musical comedy!

Our talented improvisers will conjure up a spine-chilling musical based entirely on your spooky suggestions. Expect ghostly ballads, zombie rock anthems, and more undead delights.

  • Basic Pitches: A musical show like no other! Basic Pitches will improvise an entire musical, complete with chart topping songs, from a few audience suggestions. Not to be missed!

  • Rio: A duo show exploring therapy and relationships.
entry.summary: Get ready for a frightfully fun night of improvised musical comedy!

entry.title: Introduction to Rhyming in Musical Improv

link.title: Introduction to Rhyming in Musical Improv

entry.content:
Feel like you can’t rhyme when improvising songs? Keep getting stuck down rhyming dead ends? This is the workshop for you!

In three hours, we will cover the basic building blocks of improvised rhymes!

  • How to find your flow
  • How to stay calm
  • How to successfully rhyme and land punchlines in improvised songs

…all while keeping things fun, stress-free, chill and relaxed!

The session involves a lot of writing with pen and paper, and not a huge amount of standing up alone and rhyming on the spot. And when we do rhyme, sing, or rap together, it’ll be in the form of fun shortform games! The atmosphere is always very relaxed, fun and supportive!

Rhyming is one of the things improvisers find most terrifying. This workshop will help you turn that fear into freedom and fun!

Previous improv experience preferable, but not required.
entry.summary: Feel like you can’t rhyme when improvising songs? Keep getting stuck down rhyming dead ends? This is the workshop for you!

entry.title: Improv is Back
entry.content:
Let’s celebrate the return of IMPROV to jenseits IM VIADUKT with a glorious double feature of English improv and musical improv! «Don’t Touch My Mushroom» present a surprising fully improvised theatre show with scenes never seen before. Emotions, drama, fun and everything in between.

«Basic Pitches» present a musical show like no other! Basic Pitches will improvise an entire musical, complete with chart topping songs, from a few audience suggestions.

Don’t miss out on a truly imaginative, funny, touching, co-created and most of all enjoyable evening.
entry.summary: Let’s celebrate the return of IMPROV to jenseits IM VIADUKT
